messages:
sophia: Woke up to three kv-cache flap pages in 90m. All were short (~30-70s) but still paged. We need a short-term quieting + an owner to track follow-ups.
yusuf: noted. This is `model_serving.kv_cache.flap`. Current rule pages immediately on >5x spike.
maya: short-term proposal: require 180s `for` and add 10m suppression keyed by `fingerprint(region,instance)` so repeated retries don't create new pages. Demote blips <3m to `warning`.
sophia: sounds good. owners: yusuf -> PR to change rule and push to staging; maya -> remediation ticket + runbook blurb about "flap vs sustained"; sophia -> monitor pager noise after staging deploy.
yusuf: opening PR now, will include a suppressed_events counter metric. Will post link when ready.
oncall-bot: Staging deploy recorded: prometheus/rules updated by yusuf at 1809990120.
maya: created ticket RMD-4980 and added tasks: runbook paragraph (48h), dedupe key PR (1 week), dashboard panel for suppressed_events (72h).
yusuf: PR link: https://git.internal/repo/prom-alerts/pull/811 9 includes tests and staging validation.
sophia: can we canary to two clusters in the US-west maintenance window tomorrow 09:00 PT? yusuf?
yusuf: plan: canary 09:00 PT, 30m watch, then full roll if green. Posting deploy note shortly.
maya: scheduling 30m sync Fri 16:00 UTC to review suppressed count and decide final thresholds.
sophia: after the sync, maya to close RMD-4980 with final owners and timeline. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
